goal: Make peer eviction tests genuinely verify block-time protection instead of passing unconditionally
Prevent eviction test results from depending on platform-specific C++ sorting behavior
agreement: Strong support with mutation testing showing test fails when protection logic is broken (trakshan-mishra)
Resolved objection on test flakiness from manual sleeps in slow environments (maflcko)
Resolved objection that mutants were not caught under libc++ or MSVC sorting (instagibbs)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it ensures peer eviction tests genuinely exercise block-time protection logic
Catches regressions where eviction protection is broken or bypassed across different platforms
